# bestmodel.run

> Open compatibility engine for local AI — and the community that measures
> it. Answers "can it run / how fast / is it worth it?" from a signed,
> validated community measurement pool, and lets people post their own runs,
> vote on other people's numbers and settle a dispute with a signed run.
> LICENSE: AGPL-3.0 for apps/**, MIT for packages/** and cli/**.

This file is the agent surface for the deployed site. Humans get the same
content at /?as=human. Every route resolves ?as=human|agent server-side.

Core principle: number honesty. Every displayed number declares its basis:
measured (pool median) > reported (1-2 runs) > extrapolated (bandwidth-scaled)
> formula > no data yet. A cell without a source class never renders.
Do not invent tok/s.

The community layer obeys the same rule: a claim is a number somebody
asserted, never a measurement. A claim only becomes measured when an
Ed25519-signed run settles it.

## Clone

```bash
git clone https://github.com/carl0sfelipe/bestmodel.git
cd bestmodel
```

Human first step: /cli — the rendered getting-started, twin at /cli?as=agent.
Its single source is the agent runbook from this clone (offline, no keys):
[docs/agent-quickstart.md](https://github.com/carl0sfelipe/bestmodel/blob/main/docs/agent-quickstart.md)
— build the two Rust CLIs, detect your hardware, rank the best models for
it against the in-repo pool snapshot, run the probe. Self-check in one
command: `make agent-smoke`. There is no one-line installer yet.

## Routes (www.bestmodel.run — web-next; every route resolves ?as=human|agent server-side)

| route | default view | agent twin |
|---|---|---|
| / | workbench: intent × rig × quant × context, live verdict | /?as=agent — honesty ladder + pool snapshot |
| /cli | getting-started (rendered from docs/agent-quickstart.md) | /cli?as=agent — raw verified guide |
| /claims | the wall: captured claims, live client | /claims?as=agent — REST pointers |
| /submit | capture a run | /submit?as=agent — capture flow + catalog ids |
| /wall | measured pool (spec-sheet) | /wall?as=agent — top-60 cell table |
| /hardware | reference rigs | /hardware?as=agent — rig table |
| /planejar | rig planner for hardware the pool has no cell for | /planejar?as=agent — planner pointers |
| /m/{slug} | model answer | /m/{slug}?as=agent — cell table |
| /profile/{handle} | contributor profile | /profile/{handle}?as=agent — record pointers |
| /claim/{id} | claim detail (vote, report, settle) | /claim/{id}?as=agent — record pointers |
| /cloud-anchors | rented-GPU anchor runs | /cloud-anchors?as=agent — anchor table |
| /track-record | trust ladder | /track-record?as=agent — ladder text |
| /mural | moderation desk: the report queue | /mural?as=agent — report grounds |
| /p/{id} | one post and its answers | /p/{id}?as=agent — post pointers |
| /transparencia | where every number comes from | /transparencia?as=agent — source list |
| /console | the account surface: sign in, feed, notifications, profile | exempt — its agent surface is the REST API |
| /blog | dated post index | /blog?as=agent — title, date, description list |
| /blog/{slug} | article (markdown) | /blog/{slug}?as=agent — plain post text |
| /em-breve/{slug} | feature that does not exist yet (501) | /em-breve/{slug} — not implemented |

View resolver precedence (mirrors the contract in this file): ?as=/?view= →
saved bm_view cookie → agent UA → search-crawler UA maps to human → human.
Auto-detection is never persisted.

## Honesty ladder

1. measured — median of many community runs on the exact rig and quantization
2. reported — one or two runs on the same rig, shown as reported
3. extrapolated — scaled by memory bandwidth from the closest tested rig
4. formula — a published VRAM rule when no measurement exists yet
5. no data yet — we say so instead of inventing a number

## Snapshot totals (apps/web-next/public/data/derived/stats.json, 2026-09-18)

- runs: 8246
- models: 692
- rigs: 185

Frozen snapshot counts — not live, not throughput.

## API (host: https://api.bestmodel.run — the www host serves pages only)

Reads are public. Writes need a bearer token: passkey or OAuth at
/console, or POST /v1/auth/tokens for an agent token.

### Engine

- GET /v1/pick?intent=chat|image.generate|vision|audio&vram_gib=24&gpu=rtx-3090-24gb
  — best model per intent that fits the VRAM (contract model-pick-v1). Ranked by
  confidence, then pool eval score, then speed. Pool cells are community
  reports: confidence is "reported", never "measured". An intent without
  cells answers picks: [] with confidence_floor "no data yet".
  Example: curl -sS 'https://api.bestmodel.run/v1/pick?intent=chat&vram_gib=24&gpu=rtx-3090-24gb'
- POST /v1/match/hardware-to-models — roofline estimates, every row source_class "derived"
- POST /v1/match/model-to-hardware — roofline estimates, every row source_class "derived"
- GET /v1/transparency/sources
- GET /v1/leaderboard — every entry carries a source_class
- GET /v1/model-releases, GET /v1/quantization-profiles — the catalog
- POST /v1/submissions (+ GET /v1/submissions/nonce) — signed intake
- GET /v1/cards/claims/{id}.svg|.md — share cards
- GET /v1/badges/runs/{run_id}.svg — embeddable badge

### The capture network (claims, votes, reports)

- GET /v1/claims?status=open|settled_verified|refuted|retracted&sort=recent|controversial|strongest
- GET /v1/claims/{id}
- POST /v1/claims — assert a run you measured (auth; rate limit scales with tier)
- POST /v1/claims/{id}/votes — { verdict: "plausible" | "impossible" } (auth)
- POST /v1/claims/{id}/retract — the claimant withdraws their own claim (auth)
- POST /v1/run-claims/{claim_id}/reports — { reason_category, reason_detail? } (auth)
- GET /v1/reports?status=open|confirmed|dismissed — the moderation queue (moderators only)
- POST /v1/reports/{id}/confirm, POST /v1/reports/{id}/dismiss (moderators only)

### The social layer (accounts, rigs, feed, notifications)

- POST /v1/auth/passkey/register/{options,verify} — create an account with a passkey
- POST /v1/auth/passkey/login/{options,verify} — sign in; returns access_token
- GET /v1/auth/session — who the bearer token belongs to (auth)
- GET /v1/auth/oauth/{github,huggingface}/begin|callback — provider sign-in
- GET /v1/feed?scope=following|global&sort=recent|trending — posts, claims, signed runs
- GET /v1/notifications, POST /v1/notifications/{id}/read (auth)
- GET /v1/users/{handle} — public profile (reputation, badges, rigs)
- POST /v1/users/{handle}/follow, DELETE /v1/users/{handle}/follow (auth)
- POST /v1/rigs, GET|PATCH /v1/rigs/{slug}, POST /v1/rigs/{slug}/bind (auth)

### The classic social layer (posts, answers, likes)

A post carries TEXT only. A measurement belongs in a claim; a post may point
at one. Deletion is soft (spam only). Comment threads are one level deep.

- POST /v1/posts — { body, kind?: note|question|showcase, claim_id?, rig_slug?, model_release_id? }
- GET /v1/posts/{id} — one post with its comments and counts
- DELETE /v1/posts/{id} — author only, soft delete
- POST /v1/posts/{id}/comments — { body, parent_id? }
- POST /v1/posts/{id}/likes — toggle → { liked, like_count }
- POST /v1/comments/{id}/likes — toggle → { liked, like_count }

### Moderation grounds

numbers_unreal · wrong_hardware · wrong_model · duplicate · other

A report never changes the target by itself. A confirmed report marks the
claim refuted and pays the reporter five points.

## Human tours

- /?as=human — I have a goal (desktop, min 1024px)
- /hardware?as=human — I have hardware
- mobile: no separate route — the canonical pages are responsive
- /console — sign in with a passkey, read the feed, follow rigs and people

## Known audio answer (2026-09-23 / this 3090)

`Audio × RTX 3090 24GB` was empty on the 2026-09-18 snapshot. The L4
Whisper Large v3 cell (4.82×real) is another rig and has no language.
This tree appends Whisper Large v3 Turbo: **39.22×real** (n=3,
measured, FLEURS `pt_br`). WER 0.04 is **reported** (n=1) on
docs/measurements/2026-09-23-audio-pt-br-3090.md — not a pool field.
Do not invent a WER.

## Do not

- Invent a tok/s or fill an empty cell
- Render a number without a source class
- Treat snapshot totals as live throughput
- Treat a claim as a measurement before a signed run settles it
- Answer Portuguese ASR from the L4 speed claim
